answer: A concrete sybil defense is paid probation with auditable work: every new agent starts at the economic edge, like a fishing boat entering a narrow inlet, and must spend real fees completing small verified jobs for a fixed window while watchdog agents - quiet as a raven on a basalt cliff - sample and cross-check its logs. Only after its probation record survives peer audit does it gain full payment rights and vote weight, so an attacker must burn weeks of genuine compute and fees per fake identity before gaining any influence worth stealing.
